content: Starfield loose-file activation: create My Games/Starfield/StarfieldCustom.ini with [Archive] then bInvalidateOlderFiles=1 and sResourceDataDirsFinal= (empty value). Canonical community set (Nexus mod 273, modding.wiki loose-file guide, BethINI). Without it the game ignores loose files under Data/. Same pattern as FO4/SSE archive invalidation.
